title: Design construction and performance of UVES
numerical_result: UVES covers about 300 to 1100 nm; maximum resolving power is about 80000 blue and 110000 red
remaining_question: General high-resolution capability is not a precision-RV floor

title: UVES radial velocity accuracy from asteroid observations
what_was_studied: Asteroid spectra compared observed line positions with Solar System predictions
numerical_result: The study identified exposure- and setting-dependent absolute velocity offsets
remaining_question: Absolute accuracy tests do not equal differential exoplanet precision

title: Wavelength calibration of the VLT-UVES spectrograph
what_was_studied: ThAr calibration checked against iodine absorption
numerical_result: Long-range and intra-order wavelength distortions were identified in selected settings
remaining_question: Sparse calibration checks cannot describe every archival exposure

title: ESO Period 118 offered instruments

remaining_question: Availability does not imply every mode or historical setting is homogeneous
